summary: Targeted verification of 3 small QA fixes on GlobalCalc (Next.js 16). All 3 fixes confirmed working and light regression spot-check on Percentage/Age/BMI passes cleanly. No new issues found.

verified_checks.1_discount_currency_symbol: PASS - /calculators/discount-calculator with price=80, percent=25 -> [data-testid='calc-result'] renders 'Final price $60.00' and sublabel 'You save $20.00 (25%)'. Leading '$' present on both amounts.
verified_checks.2_loan_currency_symbol: PASS - /calculators/loan-calculator with 20000/6/5 -> Monthly payment '$386.66', and stats show Principal '$20,000.00', Total interest '$3,199.36', Total payment '$23,199.36'. All have leading '$'.
verified_checks.3_discount_decimal_25.5: PASS - price=80 percent=25.5 -> final '$59.60', sublabel 'You save $20.40 (25.5%)'. No NaN/errors. fmt() correctly preserves the '.5' decimal.
verified_checks.4_age_feb29_faq_and_jsonld: PASS - Age calc page has a 'How does it handle a birthday on February 29?' accordion under 'Frequently asked questions'. Clicks open and reveals answer. <script type='application/ld+json' @type='FAQPage' mainEntity[]> includes this Feb 29 question/answer.
verified_checks.5_regression_spotcheck: PASS - Percentage 15% of 200 = 30; Age 2000-01-01 to 2024-07-01 = 24 years, 6 months, 0 days (Totals: 294 months, 1,278 weeks, 8,948 days); BMI 70kg/175cm = 22.9 Normal weight. No regression from the 3 edits.
